claims.text: Mungo was the eldest child of Balbo Baggins and Berylla Boffin. He married Laura Grubb, and they had five children together: Bungo, Belba, Longo, Linda and Bingo.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"
